invariants.enforced_by: resident-runtime/sv_work_items.py::verify_native_hb_epoch (pure over supplied ledger bytes); validate_change/validate_issue(rec, ledger_objects) apply it when ledger bytes are supplied; without them behavior is unchanged (UNKNOWN in a NATIVE record stays DENY UNKNOWN_IN_NATIVE_RECORD)
invariants.source_layout: resident-runtime/aggregate_repo_transition.py:1073-1089 (body incl. hb_reference, seal), :1092 (HEAD.json); resident-runtime/ledger_store.py:44-56 (HEAD_KEY, receipt_key); org-kernel/kernel.py:22 (HB_ANCHOR_EPOCH=32), :68-74
invariants.statement: A NATIVE record's hb_epoch (ASCII digits) equals, by integer value, $.hb_reference.epoch of the stegverse.organization-transition-receipt/v1 at its base ledger head (SV_CHANGE base_ref.ledger_head, SV_ISSUE observed_base.ledger_head), read from refs/stegverse/organization-ledger: HEAD.json at that commit -> receipts/<receipt_sha256 hex>.json, seal verified (receipt_sha256 = sha256 of the canonical body without it). The epoch is an int >= 32 (not bool, no coercion from other types) from a reference not derived from a clock (kernel.hb_reference, org-kernel/kernel.py:68-74); there is no top-level hb_epoch on the org receipt. Never read from a clock.

unobserved.next_attempt: after the org writer appends at that head
unobserved.required_evidence_or_repair: bind base_ref.ledger_head to an org-ledger receipt carrying hb_epoch

invariants.unobserved_cases: no HEAD.json, no receipt at the HEAD's digest, broken seal, not an organization-transition receipt, missing or non-int epoch, epoch < 32, derived_from_clock not false

invariants.enforced_by: resident-runtime/sv_work_items.py::derive_issue_from_check_receipt(ledger_objects, ledger_ref, row, observed_base=...) (ledger_objects: '<commit>:<path>' -> bytes of a read of refs/stegverse/organization-ledger); rule details in data/sv-work-items/required-checks.json#check_derived_issue_rule
invariants.ledger_object_shape: ledger_ref = refs/stegverse/organization-ledger@<commit>:receipts/<hex>.json names the sealed stegverse.organization-transition-receipt/v1 (aggregate_repo_transition.py:1073-1089). It carries no `evidence`; it carries boundary_evidence {operation, profile_id, disposition, communication_id} and repo_receipt_sha256 (verify_source, :627-651). The org ledger retains that sealed stegverse.repo-transition-receipt/v1 beside it at source-receipts/<hex>.json in the same commit (ledger_store.source_key, ledger_store.py:59-61; :1064-1066; organization_ledger_readback.py:89-91). The check receipt is the repo receipt's $.evidence (.stegverse/transition-ledger/emit.py:116), placed there by Lane D's sv_check_receipt append operation and self-identified by $.evidence.schema == stegverse.sv_check_receipt.v1 or $.evidence.kind == 'sv_check_receipt' (then the object minus kind must be the pinned receipt shape). boundary_evidence.operation, when present, must be 'sv_check_receipt'.

not_a_check_receipt.next_attempt: after the check receipt is appended through the sv_check_receipt operation; nothing was derived
not_a_check_receipt.required_evidence_or_repair: the repo receipt's $.evidence is a stegverse.sv_check_receipt.v1 self-identified by $.evidence.schema (or $.evidence.kind == 'sv_check_receipt'), appended by the sv_check_receipt operation

not_ledgered.next_attempt: after the org writer appends the receipt; nothing was derived
not_ledgered.required_evidence_or_repair: the org-ledger writer appends the verifier's receipt (Lane D sv_check_receipt operation); derive from the org receipt at its ledger ref and the repo receipt the org ledger retains beside it

invariants.statement: A check-derived SV_ISSUE is a deterministic derivation from the org-ledger-appended non-ALLOW check receipt: source_receipt_ref = that ledger ref (@ its receipt_sha256), failed_predicate = the receipt's failed check, surface = the check's command surface, owning_goal = the required-checks row's owning_goal. Its issue_id does not depend on who runs the derivation, so no lane owns minting: sv_work_items.derive_issue_from_check_receipt is the sanctioned derivation and fixing lanes cite the issue in resolves.

note: Invariants of the native work-items path that are not schema keywords; enforced in resident-runtime/sv_work_items.py. sv-change.v1 and sv-issue.v1 are unchanged (Lane D re-pins against 734968c0 / 62ee5307).
